entry.author: Whaikaha — Ministry of Disabled People
entry.summary:
Expression of Interest Form to join the NZ Disability Refresh Working Groups.
More information is available on our website: https://bit.ly/3Qtq0Dv

We welcome expressions of interest via video or in other alternate formats. Please send them to disabilitystrategy@whaikaha.govt.nz

Expressions of Interest are due by 6 March 2025 (note, this has been extended from the original date of 3 March 2025)
Applicants will be notified of the outcome by 21 March 2025
We hope to finalise appointments by 28 March 2025
